title: actinodaphne glauca var. subtriplinervis
intro: Actinodaphne glauca var. subtriplinervis, commonly known as the Himalayan boxwood, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. It is traditionally used in the Himalayan region for its medicinal properties and has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Actinodaphne glauca var. subtriplinervis include analgesic, antiarthritic, and antioxidant effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes and diterpenes. Research has identified the presence of compounds like ursolic acid, oleanolic acid, and linalool, which are responsible for the plant's therapeutic properties.
